text.p: Top Trader - (built 1990) 69,338 dwt 14 on 31 plus 2 del ECSA end Aug trip and redel Far East approx. $11,950 daily plus $225,000 bb Continental.
Invader - (built 1982) 64,471 dwt 13.5 on 37 plus 0.5 del Taiwan prompt Australian r/v $8,250 daily Chinese charterers.
Winter Star - (built 1978) 28,660 dwt 12.5 on 27 plus 3 del Continent Aug trip and redel Yemen $8,650 daily CNR.
Kapitan Nazarev - (built 1984) 19,252 dwt 13 on 27 plus 2.5 del Antwerp prompt trip and redel India $6,500 daily CL Line.
Jiao Cheng - (built 1978) 16,250 dwt 13 on 19 plus 2 del Tallin end Aug trip and redel India $6,100 daily CL Line.
Ocean Wind - (built 1979) 14,960 dwt del E.Med spot trip Mideast Gulf redel passing Muscat outbound $7,150 daily CNR.
Atlanticway - (built 1978) 72,100 dwt 13 on 37 plus 2.5 del U.S. Gulf early Sept trip and redel Egypt $8,100 daily plus $135,000 bb National Navigation of Cairo (adds bb rate and charterer).
Brokers advise the follwoing vessel has failed - Alpha Gemini 52,298 dwt reported on Aug 14 del U.S. Gulf 29 Aug/5 Sept trip and redel Far East $11,900 daily plus $200,000 bb Pan Ocean.
